sources.quote: mastery skills are learned automatically when the character reaches the required level; levels beyond 10 come from items, Arcana and Daevanion boards

records.newText: Skills don't level up by themselves: you spend points, and each skill level also needs a character level. Skill level L opens at the level you learned the skill + 3 × (L − 2). Savage Roar, learned at Lv 1, reaches skill level 5 at Lv 10. Each level costs 1 point (levels 2–4), 2 points (5–7) or 4 points (8–10).
records.note: The claim is wrong: skills do not gain levels on their own. Real rule (rule:skill-level-gate, rule:skill-point-cost; owner screens 2026-10-15): skill level L needs character level learnLv + 3 × (L − 2) and points cost 1 / 2 / 4 per level (L2–4 / 5–7 / 8–10). The guide text now says that, in "Where Skill Points come from".
